name: Nepal — NEB (SEE / Class 11–12)

ng_rules.note: NG in 1–2 subjects → supplementary grade-increment exam. NG in more than 2 subjects → repeat the year. No certificate until all NG cleared.

notes: Governing document: CDC Letter Grading Directive 2078 (4th amendment 2081). GPA is credit-hour-weighted: theory and internal graded separately, each grade point × its credit-hour share, summed ÷ subject credit hours; overall GPA = Σ(credit hours × grade point) ÷ Σ(credit hours).

pass_rules.note: Thresholds apply SEPARATELY per subject — below either one → NG for that subject. Same rule for SEE and +2.

percentage_estimate.label: ESTIMATE — no official GPA→percentage formula exists

traps: NO official GPA→percentage formula exists — 'GPA × 25' is estimate-only and must be labeled as such in the UI.
